::: {#rem-iteration-induction}
#### Finding a closed form, then proving it

Iteration (@def-iteration) and checking small cases, as in @exr-triple-plus-power-check, find a closed form (@def-closed-form) to try.
Induction proves it, as in @thm-double-plus-power-closed and @thm-triple-plus-power-closed,
or shows that it is wrong, as in @exm-wrong-guess.
A proof by induction needs the closed form before it starts:
it can check a formula, but it cannot find one.

:::
